apps.label: Notion
apps.about: Search and read your pages and databases.
apps.consent: Connecting here lets the tools Notion labels read-only run without asking when you ask Waldo yourself; anything else, or anything a message or page from outside prompts, asks you first. You can change this after connecting, and disconnecting then connecting here again allows them again.
